issues.description: Symbol 'internal_calc' visibility differs between the specification and the provided solution. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) explicitly instructs: "Implementieren Sie `internal_calc` als private Hilfsfunktion (nicht global)." (lines 21-22). In the solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) the helper is exported as a global symbol via the directive `global internal_calc` (line 7) and the label `internal_calc:` is defined (line 8). This contradicts the specification and may confuse students whether the helper should be non-exported (internal/private) or globally visible.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the exercise text: remove the `global internal_calc` directive from solution_repository/helloWorld.asm so `internal_calc` remains a private (non-global) helper. If there is a deliberate reason for exporting it, update problem_statement.md to mention that `internal_calc` may be global and explain why, so students are not misled.
